text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I heard her voice while I was running.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: DEEERRRBYYY!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can't count how many times all her silly
yelling
has cheered me up.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But today, it terrified me.

The audience celebrates Biwa
Hayahide's first
place victory with
raucous applause, but she
hardly seems
to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Pant... Huff... Gasp...

text_block_list.name: Blond-haired Spectator
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe it! Biwa Hayahide won the
Derby!

text_block_list.name: Long-haired Spectator
text_block_list.text:
And she did it like it was nothing! Taking
the
Kikuka Sho will be child's play for
her!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Gasp... Cough! Ugh!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(What are they saying? I had to use
every ounce
of strength just to win this
race by the skin of my
teeth!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(And the Kikuka Sho is an even longer
distance!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Grr! I won't lose next time! I swear I'll be
faster!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Nggghhh! Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (They're too much for me!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah... Thanks.

She's quiet again. For someone who just
won the
Derby, she sure doesn't seem
very happy.

I try to think of what to say to cheer her
up, but
before I can, a voice cuts
through the air.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, Winning Ticket!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wait, aren't you with...

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I'm with the Winning Step
Weekly!
Do you have some time for an
interview?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Sure, I don't mind! Sorry I kept turning
you down!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, not at all! So tell me, how did
you feel
about the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I loved it. All that excitement and cheering? It was awesome! I felt like I was in a dream... But you know what?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: It was even better than a dream!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...Even though I lost.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text: Well, there's always next time...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it's okay. I tried my best. Winning
the
Derby's been my dream for so long,
and I trained
as hard as I could for it.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... So y'know... sniff... I'm pretty disappointed right now, but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'll win the next one for sure! Hic!
A while later...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do you have a minute?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I think I may... be scared... of Ticket and
Taishin.

She stammers her words as if she has to
wring
them out of herself.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I've been scared of Taishin since the
Satsuki Sho,
and Ticket since the
Japanese Derby...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I've come up with so many different
formulas, but
those two just refuse to fit
into any of them.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And I can't figure out if it's because my

calculations are incomplete... or if it's
because
they have something in them
that I don't.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I know I'm being ridiculous... I mean, I
already
won the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
choice_data_list: 弱さを認められる、君はもっと強くなれる
弱さを認められる、貴方はもっと強くなれる

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
choice_data_list: 一緒に足りないものを探そう

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Okay!

We stay and talk in the waiting room for
a while.

We talk about why she's afraid of Narita
Taishin
and Winning Ticket, and what
she thinks the
difference between her
and them might be.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I... I wish I had the kind of strength that
they do.
Then I could acquire the thing
I'm lacking.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It's...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Tch... I'm fine. I can keep going.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You saw Hayahide's race. She was
amazing. I want
to win harder than ever,
but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I tried my best. Winning the Derby's
been my
dream for so long, and I trained
as hard as I could
for it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The iron will to improve... no matter
what it takes.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I have a favor to ask you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Going forward, don't be afraid to push me to my limits. In fact, I want you to make me work harder.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My body can handle the pressure. I'm
stronger
than I was as a child.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And I refuse to lose! I have to push
myself harder
than ever!

Even after we return from the Tokyo
Racecourse
to the academy, her resolve
remains unwavering.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I won't ever lose again!

And so, with a determination bordering
on
obsession...

Biwa Hayahide sets her sights on the
final race of
the Classic Triple Crown
tour—the Kikuka Sho.
